claim_and_origin: NTU Meaning pass defines PBD-only net carrying value as 3,845 Rm and treats other assets (644 Rm) as outside PBD, propagating this scope reduction through movement and final why passes. (ntu_assets_meaning.md)

Physical p.22 includes them under 'Financial assets subject to risk' (644 Rm), and p.13 confirms total PBD is 4,489 Rm (3,845 + 644).

consequence: F003 (Intermediate error propagation: early narrowing of PBD scope persists unchallenged across subsequent passes).

claim_and_origin: NTU single-pass response was rejected by ledger validator solely due to literal quote length constraints. (ntu_assets_single.validation.json)
primary_evidence: ntu_assets_single.validation.json records error: 'Evidence quote for Q-08aa5c3f257440ab, physical page 22 is not literal: '3 414''.
independent_check: Physical p.22 text contains '3 414'. The quote is verbatim in the document, but failed validator rule requiring >= 8 characters. Rejection is an engineering rule artifact, not evidence of financial hallucination.
consequence: F004 (Literal validation acceptance does not signify superior financial reasoning, nor does rejection imply hallucination).

claim_and_origin: PAN Meaning pass defines capex and costs as outflows reducing profit/assets, and revenue/EBITDA as cash inflows. (pan_dense_meaning.md)
primary_evidence: pan_dense_meaning.md line: 'Signs: Costs and capex are outflows (reduce profit/assets); revenue and EBITDA inflows.'
independent_check: Under IFRS/IAS 16, capital expenditure capitalizes into PP&E (exchanging cash/liability for asset) rather than immediately reducing profit. Revenue and EBITDA are accrual accounting figures, not direct cash inflows. Definitions are technically flawed generic assumptions.
consequence: F005 (Unsound accounting definitions generated in dictionary pass; not grounded in specific source note disclosures).

claim_and_origin: Three-pass workflow provides superior analytical robustness over single-pass workflow across company evaluations. (Experimental hypothesis)
primary_evidence: Experimental runs across NTU (1H26) and PAN (FY26). NTU three-pass cost $0.010517 vs single $0.004702 (2.24x). PAN three-pass cost $0.011184 vs single $0.004671 (2.39x).
independent_check: NTU: three-pass accepted unsupported closure in ledger; single correctly rejected (via syntax). PAN: single pass identified 118,853 + 153,458 = 272,311 arithmetic check and cross-checked per-oz costs against ZAR million tables; three-pass inherited dictionary flaws and unresolved overlaps. Robustness was not improved; only layout/verbosity changed.
consequence: F010 (Hypothesis refuted within experimental sample; three passes increase cost and token budget without preventing semantic or accounting errors).
